title: IncidentLens change event
description: Something that changed in a system: a deploy, a config change, a feature flag flip or a note. This is the body a client posts to the changes API. See changes/README.md and docs/adr/0005-change-events.md.

id.description: Unique ID of the event. Optional: the server assigns chg_<ULID> when it is missing. A client that sets it can retry the same post safely.

time.description: When the change took effect, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with a UTC offset. Not when it was posted; the server records that separately.

kind.description: What kind of change this is. Each kind has its own required fields, see the allOf below.

environment.description: Same value as the deployment.environment.name resource attribute of the affected services.

service.description: Same value as the service.name resource attribute of the affected service. Required for deploys. Leave it out when the change is not tied to one service.

description.description: Free text for people reading the timeline. Required for notes.

attributes.description: String key/value pairs. Some keys are required depending on kind.

source.description: What posted the event, for example github-actions, scenario-runner or a person's handle.

version.from.description: Version that was running before. Empty for the first deploy of a service.

version.to.description: Version being deployed. Must be the exact service.version string the new version reports in its telemetry.

flag.key.description: The flag's key in the flag system.

flag.value.from.description: Value before the change, as a string. Empty if the flag did not exist.

flag.value.to.description: Value after the change, as a string. Empty if the flag was removed.
